image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a cooked meatloaf resting in a metallic baking pan. The loaf is oblong with a browned, textured exterior and a visible cross-section at the front end showing a dense, pinkish-tan interior with flecks of ingredients. A glossy, reddish glaze coats parts of the surface. The background is a stark white void, suggesting a cutout or studio isolation.
